name: Kaiki Suru Seisou
source:
One Summer day I had a strange visitor. A girl who lost sight of her lover and a married woman waiting for the return of her husband. I listen to their love stories and notice that voices get broken. Hey, are you laughing right now? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某个夏日，我迎来了一位奇怪的访客。一名迷失恋人、寻找爱人的女孩，以及一名等待丈夫归来的已婚女子。我听着她们的爱情故事，注意到声音正在破碎。

喂，你现在是在笑吗？

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]）
